verdict_reason: The fixtures now key on real CN codes (0102 unweaned, 01061900 not) and still exercise the predicate, but one onSubmit title claims a retired-value rule that its assertion does not prove.

todos.issue: Title over-claims: 'Should reject a certification value the catalogue no longer offers' (onSubmit) posts 'not-a-purpose', a value the catalogue never offered, and asserts only toHaveProperty('animalsCertifiedFor'). Submit uses the generic oneOf copy, not the retired-purpose copy, so the title states a rule the assertion does not prove
todos.fix: Must: the title states what the assertion proves — an out-of-list certification is refused on submit with the generic message. One way: retitle to 'Should reject a certification value outside the catalogue on submit' and assert errors.animalsCertifiedFor equals validatorDefaults.oneOf
